changelog:
* **feat: add in-app changelog card from GitHub releases** (6cc6f2c)
  - Add ReleaseChangelog/ChangelogItem models and ChangelogParser util.
  - Fetch changelog.json from raw CDN via UpdateRepository.
  - Add Changelog card in Settings with lazy load, retry, and Bangla UI.
  - Strip trailing commit hashes in the OTA update dialog changelog.
  - Regenerate changelog.json in CI (bot.py changelog) into the OTA commit.
  - Bump versionName to 2.3.1 after v2.3.1-v2.3.6 release cleanup.
* **changelog: seed full release history [skip ci]** (be55964)
  - Generate changelog.json from live GitHub releases (v2.3.0 to v0.1.0.1).
  - Strip trailing commit hashes and TEST blocks from release entries.
  - Backfills the raw CDN changelog before the next CI release run.
* **style: modernize OTA update dialogs** (1217882)
  - Launch dialog now shows OTA title, shorter note, and real buttons.
  - Update button navigates to Settings and auto-runs the update check.
  - Update dialog shows Update available title and changelog bullets.
  - Download progress moves into the button with a live percentage.
  - Check for updates keeps a short loading state for a modern feel.
* **docs: add agent guides and git skill** (c83d10e)
  - Add AGENTS.md with build commands, architecture rules, and conventions.
  - Add docs/FILES.md with per-file reference and data-flow map.
  - Add opencode git skill for commit message and workflow rules.
* **fix: lock app to portrait orientation** (826aa80)
  - Add android:screenOrientation=portrait to MainActivity.
  - App stays in portrait on devices with auto-rotate enabled.
* **style: left-align in-words in report preview** (3a93ba1)
  - Remove centered alignment so the amount in words sits left-aligned just below the grand total.
* **style: update screen capture setting label** (7253f83)
* **style: update fingerprint verification prompt and update banner** (8e53749)
* **fix: resolve build errors and center-align PDF table values** (f8e72df)
  - Replace android Uri toURI with java URI create in OTA download.
  - Move isBangla declaration above OTA install launchers in settings.
  - Center-align denomination and subtotal columns in PDF table.
  - Center the combined grand total text within its row.
* **feat: add in-app OTA updater with manifest check and APK install** (2862de2)
  - Add UpdateManifest model and UpdateRepository contract in domain.
  - Fetch version.json and stream APK downloads via HttpURLConnection.
  - Add streaming openReportFile handle to StorageUtil with rollback.
  - Wire UpdateRepository through Hilt in RepositoryModule.
  - Add package version, size formatter and manifest parser utilities.
  - Extend SettingsViewModel with the OTA state machine and actions.
  - Add Updates card, status line, download dialog and install flow.
  - Add silent launch auto-check and update dialog in MainActivity.
  - Add INTERNET and REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES manifest permissions.
  - Add parser and size formatter unit tests with org.json test dep.
  - Document the OTA feature and network exception in the docs.
* **style: right-align PDF subtotals and un-bold grand total** (8d71ec9)
  - Subtotal values now align right inside their column instead of left.
  - Grand total row is no longer bold; label stays left aligned.
* **style: polish biometric lock, PDF table and layout details** (f5a8c30)
  - Prevent multiple biometric prompts from stacking in MainActivity.
  - Remove lock screen hint text and unused imports.
  - Remove animated typing placeholder in notes dialog.
  - Center total value text and fix PDF table vertical lines.
  - Use auto-mirrored back and text icons for RTL safety.
* **﻿style: polish UI animations, compact layouts and toggles** (0cb0926)
  - Add slide/fade transitions between screens.
  - Animate grand total count-up on the dashboard card.
  - Compact paddings and text ellipsis for small screens.
  - Convert settings rows to proper Switch toggles.
  - Left-align PDF breakdown rows and center table title.
  - Clear search field, disable empty rename save.
  - Ignore .kotlin build artifacts.
* **﻿fix: require note before saving and add back button** (39ca337)
  - Prevent saving a transaction with empty notes in the Add Notes dialog.
  - Disable the Save button until a note is entered.
  - Replace the Cancel button with Back to return to the breakdown dialog.
* **fix: haptic feedback crashes the app** (eb51da6)
  - Add missing VIBRATE permission to the manifest.
  - Wrap all vibrate calls in try-catch so haptics never crash.
* **feat: auth required on app lock toggle** (e7df9ba)
  - App lock toggle now asks for fingerprint verification before enabling or disabling.
  - Only a successful fingerprint scan changes the app lock setting.
  - Update biometric prompt title to Unlock Cash Figure App.
  - Update biometric prompt subtitle to Scan your fingerprint.
* **style: pushes the entire table section down within the PDF layout** (5787784)
* **style: modified the vertical Spacer between the breakdown table and the "Notes: " text block from 4.dp to 12.dp** (25ba77c)
* **style: update currency card title** (02dc935)
* **style: update settings labels and descs** (8be595c)
  - Update Fingerprint Lock label to App Lock.
  - Update Screenshot Block label to Screen Protection.
  - Change Miscellaneous category subtext to Add-on Features.
  - Shorten descriptions for App Lock, Screen Protection, and Haptic Feedback.
* **style: reduced the font size of the grand total amount displayed on the dashboard card** (63d59bf)
* **style: merged the two cells of the Grand Total row in the cash breakdown table** (037c7ea)
* **style: updated both CalculatorScreen.kt and ReportScreen.kt to align the "Denom." / "নোটের বিবরণ" header to the center** (ed9a511)
* **style: shortened Table Column Header** (c606b59)
  - updated the table column header from "Denomination Detail" to "Denom." in both the calculator screen and the history report screen.
  - This ensures the column header fits on a single line as requested.
* **style: formatted the Grand Total text into a single line combining the label and amount** (d8d756b)
* **style: center align table cells in PDF** (d19a3c6)
  - Change Denomination, Quantity, and Subtotal headers to be center-aligned.
  - Center-align breakdown row values across all columns.
  - Center-align Grand Total sum in Subtotal column.
